IS : 4688 - 1968

Indian Standard
SPECIFICATION FOR PROOFED COTTON DUCK GLAND PACKING
0. FOREWORD
0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 19 June 1968, after the draft finalized by the Packings and Gaskets Sectional Committee had been approved by the Mechanical Engineering Division Council. 0.2 Gland packings are used to contain fluids, gases and slurries under extreme pressure and temperatures, abrasives and other difficult conditions. This standard relates to proofed cotton duck gland packing. The requirements of other types of packing, that is, asbestos gland packing, jute and hemp or flax packing, are covered in separate standards. 0.3 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, exprcssing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 21960*. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard. 1. SCOPE 1.1 This standard deals with the requirements and methods oftests proofed cotton duck gland packing used for hydraulic services. 2. MATERIAL 2.1 The packing shall consist of layers of friction and bottom cover of rubber. Natural rubber, mixture of the two may be used.

for

cotton fabric with top synthetic rubber or a

3. DIMENSIONS 3.1 The preferred thickness of the packing shall be 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 12, 14, 15, 16, 18, 20, 22, 25, 30, 32, 35, 38, 40, 42, 45, 48 and 50 millimetres. Packing of other dimensions may be supplied subject to an agreement between the purchaser and the manufacturer.
*Ru!es for rounding off numerical values ( revised
).

I!3 : 4688- 1968 3.2 The maximum permissible variations in dimensions shall be fQ5 mm for sizes up to and including 10 mm and f 1 mm for sizes above 10 mm. 4. CONSTRUCTION 4.1 Slab stock shall be built of layers of frictioned cotton fabric laid on. a bias at 45" and in alternate directions, each ply overlapping the butted joint of the adjacent ply. There shall be at least one layer of frictioned The top and bottom layers shall be of fabric for each 2 mm thickness. natural rubber, synthetic rubber or a mixture of the two. 4.2 The surface of the packing shall be smooth andit shall not have torn out threads. 4.3 The packing shall be coiled into spirals with the edges of the laminations forming the inside and outside surfaces and vulcanized. The inside coil diameter shall not be less than four times nor more than six times the thickness of the finished packing, the cross-section being square. 4.4 Lubrication graphited. The packing shall be lubricated by mineral oil and

5. WORKMANSHIP 5.1 The packing shall show no evidence 6. SAMPLING 6.1 Lot - Th e quantity of coils of packing of the same size and of one definite quality, delivered to one buyer against one despatch note shall constitute a lot. 6.2 The conformity of a lot to the requirements of this standard shall be determined on the basis of the tests carried out on the samples selected from the lot. 6.3 Unless otherwise agreed to between the manufacturer ,\nd the purchaser, the number of coils to be selected at random from a lot shall be in accordance with co1 1 and 2 of Table 1. 6.4 The coils selected according to 6.3 shall be insprc-ted for construcIf the number of coils found not tion, workmanship and dimensions. in conformity with the specified requirements, is less than or equal to the corresponding number given in co1 3 of Table 1, the lot shall be declared conforming to the requirements of visual and dimensional characteristics. 6.5 In case of those lots which have been found satisfactory according to 6.4, a number of coils equal to the sample size given in col 4 of 4 of poor workmanship.

Table 1 shall be selected from those coils tested according to 6.4. The specimens cut from these coils shall be subjected to tests given in 7.2, 7.3 and 7.4. The lot shall be declared conforming to the requirements of this specification if all the coils satisfy the relevant requirements.

coil selected in accor1 shall be inspected for the construction, dance with co1 2 of Table workmanship and dimensions. The dimensions shall be measured to an accuracy of 0:l mm with a slide-gauge at three different places in two perpendicular directions. The mean of the six measurements thus made shall be within the variation specified at 3.2.

NOTE -The use of the IS1 Certification Mark is governed by the provisions of the Indian Standards Institution ( Certification Marks) Act and the Rules and Re ulations made thereunder. The ISI Mark on products covered by an Indian s tandard conveys the assurance that they have been produced to comply with the requirements of that standard under a well-defined system of inspection, testing and quality control which is devised and supervised by ISI and operated by the producer. IS1 marked products are also CO: tinuously checked by IS1 for conformity to that standard as a Details of conditions under which a licence for the use of the ISI further safeguard.
